content: There are several CRF libraries, such as CRF++, CRFsuite. These machine learning toolkits can be used to solve the task by providing an annotated corpus with extracted features. The toolkit will be used to train a model based on the corpus and extract a tagging model. The tagging model will then be used to tag on input text without annotated corpus. In the training and tagging stages, extracting features from the corpus and the input text is necessary for both stages.
